feeds.title: Following The Thread
feeds.description: I'm Melanie. I'm a sewing enthusiast who loves to learn new things. I've been sewing at a basic level for years but in the last few years have really returned to my love of sewing. It's been non-stop ever since, with always another project to make, another class to take, or another book to read.

feeds.title: Everything Sewing
feeds.description: My name is Ann. I live in Nova Scotia and love to sew garments, doll clothes, and bags. I like to learn new techniques as I make my items. Everything Sewing includes sewing, knitting, lifestyle, and whatever else is on my mind.

feeds.title: Janome Life
feeds.description: From beginner to artisan; sharing what we love about Janome sewing machines for sewing, creating, and quilting. Janome Canada is a member of the Janome Sewing Machine Co. Ltd. global family of subsidiaries, based in Japan. We have a rich heritage of manufacturing excellence and design innovation.

feeds.title: At the Corner of Scraps and Quilts
feeds.description: Whether you're walking down Scraps Road or up Quilts Street,hope you find your visit interesting and sweet.

feeds.title: Anja Quilts
feeds.description: I am Anja. I am an Executive Assistant by day, a quilter by night, and a Girl Guide all the time.

feeds.title: Crazy Quilter on a Bike!
feeds.description: A blog about the daily life of a CRAZY quilter. How to organize your stash and yourself and when I have time - it's all about the bike.

feeds.title: The Cozy Quilter
feeds.description: Posts feature different types of quilt designs and inspiration. As a child, I slept under quilts made by my grandmother. I started making quilts as a teenager and have made several quilts over the years.

feeds.title: True Blue Canadian
feeds.description: I am Dolores. Wife, mother, mother-in-law and proud grandmother to nine adorable little people. Besides quilting, I love to sew garments, cross stitch, embroider, crochet and knit.

feeds.title: The Sewing Lawyer
feeds.description: A Lawyer who has pursued sewing as a hobby. Winner of Active wear pattern review. Find articles on sewing tutorials, patterns and new ideas.

feeds.title: Applique and Patch Quilting
feeds.description: HI! I'm Rose Marie crazy about applique and patch quilts and hand quilting. Married for 44 years and retired. Living in North Bay, Ontario, Canada. My blog is about my passion for quilting and just a little bit about my life and family. I make the quilts that my heart tells me to.

feeds.title: Crafting A Rainbow
feeds.description: I am Gillian. I love sewing and crafting of all kinds! I'm a teacher in small-town Ontario.

feeds.title: Terry Aske Art Quilt Studio
feeds.description: Hi! I am Terry, and I share tips and techniques that I developed, discovered, and refined during the years I've been quilting. I also share both art quilts and abstract/modern quilts that I create in a contemporary style.

feeds.title: Sewing Therapy
feeds.description: Hello, My name is Sara. I've been sewing for over 5 years now. I live in Vancouver, BC. I've been running my online fabric stores for over 4 years now. Once I started the studio, I realized that one of my passion is sharing knowledge and tips on sewing with others. So whoever has a passion for sewing can learn it easy and focus more on what they would like to focus on!

feeds.title: Fabricville Canadian Sewing Blog
feeds.description: At Fabricville, it is really about being creative with fabrics! Take a look at our sewing blog for more inspiration from our designers and tell us what you think!

feeds.title: Love to Sew Podcast
feeds.description: Helen Wilkinson and Caroline Somos host Love to Sew, a fun weekly podcast about making clothes, sewing community, and small business. They talk about their passion for sewing a handmade wardrobe and their daily lives as creative entrepreneurs. Listen to interviews with indie business owners and inspiring sewists who totally understand your obsession with sewing.

feeds.title: Blackbird Fabrics
feeds.description: Curated for sewists by sewists, Blackbird Fabrics offers a collection of modern, high-quality garment fabrics available to shop on our online store.

feeds.title: Boots and Cats
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Katryna and welcome to my blog. I like sewing, illustration, and making crafty messes. And cats. I also like cats. I am a seamstress, a graphic designer, a photographer, a crafter, a consumer, a painter, a writer, a print maker, an illustrator, an explorer, and a person who makes mistakes. Join me on the journey of discovery.

feeds.title: Cathy Tomm Quilts
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest articles from Cathy Tomm Quilts Blog. Cathy Tomm is an Art Quilter, Longarm Quilter, Scrapbooker, Horse Rider, Dog Agility Competitor, Mother, and Wife.

feeds.title: Helen Closet Patterns Blogs
feeds.description: At Helen's Closet Patterns, we are passionate about creating thoughtful, well-designed, and timeless sewing patterns. Sew your dream wardrobe, follow our blog and social media for new pattern hacks, wardrobe inspiration, and sewing tips!

feeds.title: Closet Core Patterns Blog
feeds.description: I'm Heather Lou, a pattern designer and sewing educator for the modern maker. Providing you with sewing patterns, tools & techniques to help you create a self-made wardrobe you can wear with pride.

feeds.title: Baudekin Studio Blog
feeds.description: Couture Sewing Blog is a seamstress blog about sewing, fashion, couture fabrics. If you want to learn how to sew, expand your knowledge about rare fabrics, and educate yourself about the current issues facing the fashion and textile industries, then join us.
